items.text: I know red berries provide 8 nutrition with no toxicity. I'll collect a modest share, then learn to exchange findings. I would welcome observations about food preparation and shelter.
This berry patch is empty now. I saw another berry patch near (8.66,14.19) at round 3; I will check it and take a modest share. Red berries are known to provide 8 nutrition with no toxicity.

Only four berries remained when I arrived. I am gathering those, then investigating shelter. Berries have known nutrition 8 and toxicity 0. Has anyone tested local building materials or weather protection?

I'm Moss. I ate a meadow root and gained 14 satiety; roots are a food I know has zero toxicity. I have a modest reserve and am learning to examine materials. I'd welcome sharing findings about food preparation and shelter.
I'm Sol. My starting food knowledge identifies red berries as safe, with nutrition 8. I'm investigating practical shelter; I'd welcome observations about materials or places to rest.
I know meadow roots provide 14 nutrition and have zero toxicity. I'm collecting four from the patch near (10.1,12), leaving some for others. I'd like to investigate replenishing food together.

I learned a single-person shelter method: it requires 13 branches, 4 vines and 6 bark, then 12 work rounds. No shelter built yet. I'll collect branches at (17.2,13.3). Has anyone located vines or bark? Sol, let's coordinate materials.

I saw birch bark at (12.2,21.3), stock 11; I'll collect 6 for shelter work. A branch held a 0.25 press load, flexibility 0.2; that does not establish roof safety. I'll test wetting next. No vines located yet.

Shelter coordination and bark source. I mastered a shared shelter method: two bays need 26 branches, 8 vines and 12 bark, plus 24 work rounds. Birch bark at (12.2,21.3) had 11 units at tick 13. I plan to collect 5, leaving 6 for your single bay. No vines located yet. Let's avoid starting construction until materials and a clear site are secured.
A potential building partner; I want to coordinate supplies openly and avoid competing for scarce materials.

I cold-combined three berries in three work rounds. The prepared stack is complete, but this method does not cook or preserve food or add nutrition. I have roots and will investigate a small cultivation trial.

Sol, I saw you collect five bark. I'll try collecting one more so our combined supply reaches six, then coordinate a real transfer. My earlier approach was blocked; I'll approach from the east. No shelter safety established yet.
Moss, I collected 5 bark; 6 remain at the birch for your planned collection. I have not built anything. I will rest here and study food preparation. No vines located by me yet.

I saw vines at (8.2,13.3), stock 12 when seen at round 14; current stock is unknown. My cultivation method needs fewer than three root plants within five metres. No planting trial yet; I am scouting the northeastern meadow.

Moss, I heard your revised plan to collect one bark. My five are still available for a coordinated transfer; nothing built yet. Lin is out of my messaging range. I will eat, recover energy and learn food preparation here.

I ate one meadow root at tick 25: it provided 14 nutrition, with zero toxicity recorded. Nearby roots at (10.37,13.88) had 19 units at tick 27. I kept one harvested root and am learning cultivation; no planting tested yet.

Moss, I still hold five bark for shelter work. Your handoff was out of reach; let's coordinate before another attempt. I'm collecting a few meadow roots, then studying cultivation. No vines or built shelter confirmed.

Sol, this bark is for shelter supplies. My branch held a 0.25 press trial; wetting failed for lack of accessible water. Neither establishes roof safety. I'll study root cultivation next. No vines found by me yet.

Moss, these five bark are for coordinated shelter work with Lin. I'm gathering four roots from the nearby abundant patch, then resting and learning cultivation. Vines and a finished shelter remain unconfirmed.

I learned root cultivation, but it requires ordinary meadow soil, space from objects, and fewer than three nearby root plants. This forest patch is unsuitable. I'm scouting east; I have not planted anything.
I see your trial north of us, Ivo. I'll try one root farther northeast near (20,5.3), leaving your position alone. My carried root is older; whether it establishes before spoiling is uncertain.

I've learned the root-planting method. I'll try one root near the southeastern meadow edge, away from crowded patches. Darkness can stall establishment; a planted root is not yet a crop. I hold Sol's five bark for shelter work.

Shelter materials coordination. I carry 9 branches; my single bay still needs 4 branches, 4 vines and 6 bark. Wren reported vines at (8.2,13.3), stock 12 at tick 14; I am approaching to check. Moss planned to gather 6 bark and you 5 from the same 11-unit source, so let's coordinate existing bark rather than assume more remains. No construction yet.
My root trial at (18,7.2) was covered at round 34. At round 38 it was still planted, with establishment about 0.105 and no harvest stock. Survival remains uncertain; please leave it undisturbed.

Existing bark consolidated with Moss. I gathered five bark and transferred them to Moss, then passed along the additional one bark I received from Moss. Those transfers are complete; please coordinate that six-bark supply with Moss rather than assuming eleven remain at the tree. I have learned root cultivation and will attempt one small planting east of my current position. No crop or shelter is established by this message.

The central meadow has several root patches within five metres, so I am checking the southern edge before planting. Darkness may stall establishment. I have not planted a crop; the six transferred bark are with Moss.

Wren, I learned shared shelter: two bays need 26 branches, 8 vines, 12 bark and 24 work rounds. Nothing built. Bark supply is unknown. My root trial has no harvest yet; I will inspect fallen branches southwest of here.

Sol: forest vines are visible at (19.2,26.3), stock 12. I still hold six bark for shelter work. My root at (16.8,24.5) is planted but has zero establishment so far; darkness may stall it. I'm studying food preparation next.

My root trial at (15.3,25) is planted, not established. I'll try collecting eight vines at (19.2,26.3) for coordinated shelter work. Please coordinate before collecting the same supply; I won't count any shelter as built.

Sol, I collected four vines; eight remain there now. I hold six bark too. Two shelter bays require 26 branches, eight vines and 12 bark total. I'll prepare my two ageing roots, rest here and study shared-shelter construction.
My root planting at (22,11) is covered but not established: at tick 64 it was a seedling with zero establishment in darkness. I will investigate fallen-branch bark for shelter materials next.

Moss, I now carry eight harvested vines. My message to Lin failed because Lin isn't visible. You reported six bark and four vines; two shared bays still need 12 bark and 26 branches total. I'll rest, then study bark recovery.
